title: Knighthood
summary: KNIGHTHOOD, noun The character or dignity of a knight. 1. A military order, honor, or degree of ancient nobility, conferred as a reward of valor or merit. It is of four kinds, military, regular, honor

inlines.v: KNIGHTHOOD, noun The character or dignity of a knight. 1. A military order, honor, or degree of ancient nobility, conferred as a reward of valor or merit. It is of four kinds, military, regular, honorary, and social.
